title.en: The web app now has a design, and the update API is live
title.zh: 网页应用有了设计，更新接口也已就绪

summary.en: The designer delivered the full web-app design: clickable mockups in English, 简体中文 and 繁體中文, light and dark, phone to desktop, plus a design system and glossary. You answered the five open design questions and they are in the design. On the backend, the update admin API (R-020) is merged. Nothing of the real web app is built yet; the screenshots below are of the design mockup, not of working software.
summary.zh: 设计师交付了完整的网页应用设计：可点击的原型（英文、简体中文、繁體中文，浅色与深色，手机到桌面），以及设计系统和术语表。你回答的五个设计问题已经落实到设计中。后端方面，更新管理接口（R-020）已合并。真正的网页应用还没有开始开发；下面的截图来自设计原型，而不是可运行的软件。

text.zh: 设计已交付 · 下一步开发界面

sub.en: reported at merge, not re-run for this report
sub.zh: 合并时报告，本期未重新运行

title.zh: 你分享的 / 与你共享
你的五项设计决定，已落实

bullets.zh: 文件扩展名**显示**，不隐藏。

bullets.en: Settings keeps the Automatic / Light / Dark control; the default is Automatic (follows the system).
bullets.zh: 设置中保留“自动 / 浅色 / 深色”切换，默认自动（跟随系统）。

bullets.en: A **Shared with you** tab is added next to Shared by you (visible in the screenshot above). It needs new backend work, tracked as R-071.
bullets.zh: 在“你分享的”旁边新增**与你共享**标签页（见上方截图）。它需要新的后端工作，记为 R-071。

bullets.en: The public share page gets a language switch.
bullets.zh: 公开分享页增加语言切换。

bullets.en: Phone number fields get a country picker. This needs E.164 storage and validation on the backend, and any SMS provider with a running cost will need your approval first.
bullets.zh: 手机号输入增加国家/地区选择器。后端需要按 E.164 存储与校验；任何有运行成本的短信服务商都需要先经你批准。

bullets.en: **R-020 update admin API** is merged into the manager branch: current and latest version, check, install, and settings, all behind the admin guard.
bullets.zh: **R-020 更新管理接口**已合并到经理分支：当前与最新版本、检查、安装、设置，全部受管理员权限保护。

bullets.en: **R-060 / R-061 account approval** is merged (new accounts wait for an administrator). HTTP-level tests come with R-066.
bullets.zh: **R-060 / R-061 账户审批**已合并（新账户需管理员批准）。HTTP 层测试在 R-066 中补上。

title.en: Risks and what was not verified
Tests not re-run for this report

text.en: The 94 unit tests are the count reported when R-020 was merged. This session could not run the test suite, so the number is not freshly confirmed.
text.zh: 94 项单元测试是 R-020 合并时报告的数字。本次会话无法运行测试，所以这个数字并非刚刚确认。

title.en: No live check of the new APIs

text.en: R-020 and the approval flow have not yet been exercised with curl against a running instance.
text.zh: R-020 和审批流程还没有在运行实例上用 curl 实测。

text.en: The design was checked by its own smoke test and in screenshots, but has not been tried on a real phone.
text.zh: 设计通过了自带的冒烟测试并拍了截图，但还没有在真实手机上试过。

bullets.en: Start the web-app foundation (R-003), and the backend for Shared with you (R-071).
bullets.zh: 开始网页应用基础（R-003）以及“与你共享”的后端（R-071）。

bullets.en: Device packaging (R-021), the HTTP integration tests (R-030, R-066) and the idle-code sweep (R-070).
bullets.zh: 设备打包（R-021）、HTTP 集成测试（R-030、R-066）以及闲置代码清理（R-070）。
